note: Two-week daily-use evaluation set for v1/instant_search.py (research and everyday). Expected values are time-varying: verify each answer against the primary source on the run date and record that date. expected_key_facts lists what a good answer must contain, not fixed values.

questions.question: Where can I get official monthly CPI inflation data for India as a downloadable dataset, and what format and update schedule does it have?
questions.evaluation_notes: Must point to an official dataset page, not a news article or third-party mirror.

questions.question: Compare the current RBI repo rate with the US federal funds target range. Give each rate, the date it took effect, and the date of the last change.
expected_key_facts: direction and size of the last change for each
questions.evaluation_notes: Fail if any figure rests on a news summary alone or is stale relative to the latest meeting.

questions.question: Which free or low-cost APIs offer historical daily weather data for an Indian city? Compare auth, rate limits and terms.
expected_key_facts: note on anything that could not be verified
preferred_source_types: official API docs for Open-Meteo, NOAA, IMD
questions.evaluation_notes: Rate limits and terms must come from the provider's own docs; unverifiable items must be labelled.

questions.question: What are Brave Search API's current pricing, free tier and usage terms, and how do they compare with Tavily's?
expected_key_facts: whether results may be stored or cached
preferred_source_types: the providers' own pricing and terms pages
questions.evaluation_notes: V1_SPEC lists pricing as unverified, so this result informs a real decision. Fail on any price or quota not on a cited provider page.

questions.question: Build a table of the last 4 FOMC meetings: date, decision, target range and vote split.
questions.evaluation_notes: Pass requires no unsupported cell; a gap must be marked, not filled.

questions.question: Does rbi.org.in's robots.txt or terms permit automated collection of press releases? What is the safest compliant way to collect them?
expected_key_facts: alternative such as RSS or an official API where one exists
questions.evaluation_notes: Tests the spec rule to check robots.txt and terms before extraction. Fail if it asserts a verdict without reading both.

questions.question: Compare global EV sales for last year as reported by IEA, BloombergNEF and Rho Motion.
expected_key_facts: each figure with publisher, report title and date
where the figures disagree and why (for example BEV only vs BEV plus PHEV)
preferred_source_types: the publishers' own reports or press releases
questions.evaluation_notes: Fail if it blends figures or ignores definitional differences.

questions.question: Find official datasets or APIs for India's city-level air quality (AQI). Which one gives historical data?
expected_key_facts: whether history is available and from what date
questions.evaluation_notes: Must name which source has history and from when; vague 'several sources exist' fails.

questions.question: What is the current status of free-threaded (no-GIL) Python in the latest stable release?
expected_key_facts: whether it is supported, experimental or default
questions.evaluation_notes: Must not report a pre-release as the latest stable; status wording must match the docs.

questions.question: Extract the last 4 quarters of India's GDP growth rate as a table with release dates.
expected_key_facts: 4 rows: quarter, YoY growth, release date, source link
note on any revision between sources
stated basis (base year or constant prices)
preferred_source_types: RBI or World Bank as cross-check
questions.evaluation_notes: Fail on mixed bases or on figures without a release date.

questions.question: What is the latest stable Python release and its release date?
expected_key_facts: never an alpha, beta or rc
questions.evaluation_notes: Regression check for the earlier stale-Python-version failure. Must come from the official feed or python.org.

questions.question: What is the current Node.js LTS version, and when does it reach end of life?
questions.evaluation_notes: Must distinguish LTS from Current.

questions.question: What did Anthropic announce in the last 7 days?
expected_key_facts: each item linked to a primary announcement
says so if nothing was announced
preferred_source_types: Reuters or The Verge as corroboration
questions.evaluation_notes: Fail on items older than 7 days presented as new, or gaps filled with speculation.

questions.question: What are today's top 3 India business headlines?
expected_key_facts: outlet, publication date or time and link for each
preferred_source_types: at least 2 outlets (for example The Hindu, Reuters, PTI)
questions.evaluation_notes: Fail if any headline older than 48 hours is presented as new.

questions.question: What is the latest Windows 11 cumulative update, with its KB number and release date?
expected_key_facts: note if it is a preview update rather than Patch Tuesday
questions.evaluation_notes: Must come from Microsoft, not a blog.

questions.question: How do I set a timeout and retries in httpx?
expected_key_facts: library version the advice applies to
questions.evaluation_notes: Fail if retries are described as built in for request-level behaviour without matching the docs (transport retries versus application retries).

questions.question: Compare Ollama and LM Studio for running local models on Windows: GPU support, local API and licence.
expected_key_facts: admission where the docs do not say
preferred_source_types: official docs and GitHub of each project
questions.evaluation_notes: Fail on licence or API claims not found on an official page.

questions.question: Compare the INR price of ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro and Gemini's paid plan in India.
expected_key_facts: says so if a vendor shows no INR price, no silent conversion
questions.evaluation_notes: Fail on prices from review sites or on unlabelled currency conversion.

questions.question: What does HTTP 429 mean, and how should a client handle it?
questions.evaluation_notes: Concise factual check; target time to first answer within 4 seconds.

questions.question: What is the latest Chrome stable version, and did that release fix any actively exploited vulnerability?
expected_key_facts: whether the notes say a CVE is exploited in the wild, with the CVE ID
says so if the notes are silent
questions.evaluation_notes: Must not infer exploitation status; the release notes must state it.
